$comment: Default LLM models per provider for each pipeline step. Pick the active provider with `php bin/build.php --provider=<name>` or the LLM_PROVIDER env var (falls back to default_provider below). Every step is tagged with a tier (design | code | small); the active provider's model for that tier is used. Design = the creative steps that decide what the site looks like; code = the steps that emit block markup, CSS and PHP from a direction already decided; small = fast/cheap structural steps. OVERRIDES (any model id, always win, in this order): LLM_MODEL_<STEP> for one step (e.g. LLM_MODEL_SITE_SPEC=gpt-5.5), then LLM_MODEL_DESIGN / LLM_MODEL_CODE / LLM_MODEL_SMALL for one tier, then LLM_MODEL for both non-small tiers.
